objective: Test frozen v4.4 on five new public job bodies selected only from source-observable category and experience surface cues.
claim_boundary: This purposive five-job holdout can test cross-job and cross-delivery-surface behavior of the two frozen compatibility mechanisms. It cannot estimate population accuracy or justify broader ontology aliases.

strata.source_only_predicate: A responsibility or qualification statement contains a case-insensitive whole-phrase match for 'knowledge of', 'knowledge in', or 'working knowledge'.
strata.purpose: Test category-vocabulary behavior near the knowledge cue.

strata.source_only_predicate: A responsibility or qualification statement contains a case-insensitive whole-word match for motivation, motivated, passion, curiosity, curious, drive, or enthusiasm.
strata.purpose: Test category-vocabulary behavior near attitude cues.

strata.source_only_predicate: A qualification statement contains an explicit 0-N years/months range with integer N greater than zero, using hyphen, en dash, em dash, or 'to'.
A responsibility or qualification statement explicitly uses skill, skills, capability, or capabilities and contains none of the registered C1/C2 cue phrases in that statement.
strata.purpose: Detect category alias over-activation on already formal language.

strata.source_only_predicate: A qualification statement contains a positive experience lower bound such as 1-N years, 2+ years, or minimum 1 year and contains no explicit 0-N years/months range.

selection_protocol.assignment: Select the first eligible repository-novel posting found for each stratum in the frozen query order; freeze its stratum assignment even if the body also matches another stratum.
frozen_query_order: site:jobs.lever.co AI engineer motivation curiosity passion
selection_protocol.search_result_rule: Within each query, inspect results in displayed rank order and record every rejection reason before accepting the first eligible result.
eligibility: Publicly accessible complete English-language job body.
AI/ML engineer or directly equivalent hands-on technical role.
At least 1500 Unicode characters after deterministic normalization.
Contains separately identifiable responsibilities and qualifications.
Posting is open or publicly displayed at collection time.
Unique company, source URL, and job body within this holdout.
Not an AI-campus source and not an employer/job used in prior JSON data.
forbidden_selection_inputs: manual preference after an eligible first result is found

G5-source-surface-and-granularity.per_case_primary_atom_floor: Half the source-observable responsibility and qualification statement count, rounded up and frozen before requests.

decision_rule.confirmed_both_mechanisms_generalize: G0-G6 pass; both new v4.4 diagnostic codes activate at least once; every newly activated case is v4.3-invalid only for an eligible incompatibility and becomes v4.4-valid.
decision_rule.partial_mechanism_generalization: G0-G6 pass; exactly one new mechanism activates and restores all of its eligible invalid cases; the other positive stratum remains valid without needing its compatibility mechanism.
decision_rule.supported_non_regression_only: G0-G6 pass; no new mechanism activates and all five raw outputs are already strict-valid under v4.3.
decision_rule.failed: Any G0-G6 gate fails, an eligible activation does not restore strict validity, a negative control activates, or reverse replay is inexact.

stop_condition: After preregistration, collect and freeze five source bodies only. Stop before creating or sending requests until separate user authorization.
